messages:
pagerbot: PAGED: auth-proxy alert — unusual token churn detected on prod-west. 1500 requests/min with 401->200 pattern. Priority: P1. https://alerts.redwood.example/alerts/4387 :rotating_light:
alex: on it. confirming oncall. grabbing logs from edge proxy now.
maria: i see the burst, looks like service-account tokens being replayed from multiple ips, some UA strings look like bot/okhttp.
sam: any customer-facing errors? metrics show a slight spike in 500s for inference-route /v1/generate for a few mins. not widespread but 5 customers hit with degraded throughput.
jamie: assigning myself to traffic containment + rules. alex you take traceback and key rotation decision with security.
oncall-eng: acked. jumping into k8s for pod-level traces.
alex: quick check: logs show repeated calls with header `X-Service-Token: svc_XXXX` — token TTLs look normal but we see replay after token creation. suspects: leaked token, or compromised CI key.
maria: confirm: leaked token would require rotating the svc token and revoking sessions. do we have a short diff of affected token ids?
alex: pulling list — `egrep -o "svc_[A-Za-z0-9]{8}" /var/log/proxy/access.log | sort | uniq -c | sort -nr | head` -> returns 12 unique tokens with high counts.
sam: raising incident impact: affected customers: cust-alpha, cust-gamma, cust-delta. support-lead loop in for B2B comms.
support-lead: on it, preparing targeted messages; will wait for official root cause and rotation confirmation before emailing.
jamie: mitigation plan: 1) add temporary WAF rule blocking suspicious UA/ip ranges, 2) throttle tokens with >100 req/min, 3) rotate svc tokens flagged, 4) revoke all active sessions for affected tokens, 5) coordinate legal and notify customers.
legal: please capture timeline and any PII exposures; initiate legal review if tokens map to account-level data.
alex: rotation steps (proposed):
```
# rotate token for service-account
redwoodctl iam service-accounts rotate-key --id svc-1234 --confirm
# revoke sessions
redwoodctl sessions revoke --token svc_XXXX
```

alex: Need ops to run rotate in safe window, will prepare canary. jamie can you apply WAF throttle?
jamie: applying ip block + throttle now, testing on canary cluster first (canary-edge-2).
jamie: applied, canary saw immediate drop in replay traffic, auth attempts down 85% there. rolling to prod-west in 2 mins.
oncall-eng: can we get a list of impacted tokens and affected customer IDs to scope rotation? alex pls paste when ready.
alex: pasted list to secure channel (redwood-secured/incident-1769998887). not including here.
sam: confirming customer impact: cust-alpha reported elevated latency and a 10-min window of failed jobs, cust-gamma saw 3% error budget burn. overall SLA not breached but close.
support-lead: drafting message for those three customers, will include mitigation steps and ETA for rotation.
legal: tag me when you have the final list of accounts and any exported logs.
alex: prepping rotation playbook now. will coordinate with infra to do staged rotations (canary service-account -> batch rotate -> full rotate). ETA 25m.
maria: after rotate, we should enable short-lived tokens for that SA and enforce mTLS for internal calls. file as TODO for postmortem.
support-lead: sending interim note to affected customers: "We've detected suspicious token replay that affected your requests — we've applied mitigations and will rotate tokens. No evidence of data exfiltration so far. We'll follow up with details"
jamie: rotation started for canary tokens at 1769998950, no regressions. proceeding to batch.
alex: batch rotate done for top 8 tokens at 1769999010. revoking sessions in parallel.
maria: telemetry looks good — replay traffic collapsed, error rates normalizing.
legal: received logs, starting analysis.
support-lead: sent targeted emails to cust-alpha/gamma/delta with contact for follow-up.
pagerbot: INCIDENT UPDATE: containment in progress; major mitigations applied; partial rotations complete. P1 -> monitoring.
jamie: followups: rotate remaining lower-volume tokens, audit CI credential stores for accidental leak, add rate-limiting rules by token fingerprint, run a full session audit.
alex: creating incident ticket and postmortem outline. CC: security, infra, devex.
sam: handoff: alex and jamie will drive resolution, oncall-eng monitors for 2h, support-lead to continue customer comms.
alex: handing to monitoring phase; if we see any replays after 2h, escalate to full org.
support-lead: will update status page with a short note in 10m.
jamie: thanks team. filing RCA items. :white_check_mark:
